# Newsletter

## Subscribe to Our Newsletter

```{=html}
<style>
  #subscribe-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    max-width: 500px;
    gap: 10px;
    margin: 1em 0;
  }

  #subscribe-form input[type="email"] {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 200px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border: 2px solid #ccc;
    border-radius: 8px;
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
  }

  #subscribe-form input[type="email"]:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #007acc;
  }

  #subscribe-form button {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #007acc, #00bfa5);
    color: white;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.2s;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  }

  #subscribe-form button:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #005fa3, #009e88);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  #subscribe-form button:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  #message {
    display: none;
    color: green;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-top: 1em;
  }
</style>

<form id="subscribe-form">
  <input type="email" name="email" required placeholder="Enter your email" />
  <button type="submit">📬 Subscribe</button>
</form>

<div id="message">
  ✔ You've been subscribed to the OxInfer Newsletter :)
</div>

<script>
  document.getElementById('subscribe-form').addEventListener('submit', function(event) {
    event.preventDefault(); // Stop normal form submission

    const form = event.target;
    const formData = new FormData(form);

    fetch('https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwPL438sqcd6WOqiKUMeD0OsT0QoSUAU5efR3Tj6rjggtdAoU8JqJjIEJnOJPjkB-8/exec', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData
    })
    .then(response => response.text())
    .then(text => {
      // Hide the form and show the success message
      form.style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('message').style.display = 'block';
    })
    .catch(error => {
      alert('Oops, something went wrong. Please try again.');
      console.error(error);
    });
  });
</script>
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here("newsletter", "createNewsletter.R"))

period <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2025-01-01"), to = Sys.Date(), by = 1) |>
  rev() |>
  format("%B %Y") |>
  unique()

readr::read_csv(here::here("newsletter", "packages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$dev == "ox") |>
  dplyr::select(!"dev") |>
  createNewsletter(period = period) |>
  cat()
```
